brief: William Law was born in 1686 and was ordained priest in 1728. Unable to hold any office in the church because he refused to acknowledge George I as the rightful king, he devoted much of his life to writing. The book for which he is most remembered today was published in 1728: A Serious Call to a Devout and Holy Life. He advocated a strictly disciplined life of personal holiness. His later writings show a mystical emphasis on the indwelling of Christ in the heart. He died in 1761.
